a much loved brand among consumers 
around the world. We believe this is 
something to embrace, not shy away 
from and are keen on building on this 
rich heritage as we continue to break the 
limitations of the smartphone industry.

cellphone, and then went on to dominate 
the cellphone world with the Razr.

The Motorola World
Our world is young, spirited, and future 
forward. The perfect combination of style 
and engineering: Bold, but premium.

and irreverent twist to it.
